title: claim_released event payload
$comment: Class: OPTIONAL_SPEC_ID. AUTH-BINDING-BRIDGE-001: explicit relinquishment of a bridge binding by the owning session (caws claim --release). Bare release names the spec it freed; one event per removed binding. Retire-by-spec-close does NOT emit this (the audit trail for that is spec_closed/spec_archived).

session_id.description: The session that released the binding (must be the owner).

scope.description: named = --release --spec <id> targeted one binding; bare = --release freed every binding the session owned (this event names the one freed).
